Caught at the Sedgewick HotelHow to make it250g spinach150g marinated artichokes, drained150g cream cheese, softened100g sour cream100g grated mozzarella30g grated parmesan1 garlic clove, crushed200g corn chipsWilt the spinach in a dry pan, cool, then squeeze very dry and chop with the artichokes.Mix the spinach and artichokes with the cream cheese, sour cream, most of the mozzarella, the parmesan and the garlic.Spoon into a small baking dish, top with the rest of the mozzarella and bake at 190°C for 20 minutes until bubbling.Serve hot with the corn chips for scooping.Fridge devilled eggsOpen the fridge slowly. Zuul lives in thereHow to make it6 eggs3 tbsp mayonnaise1 tsp Dijon mustardgreen food colouring, a dropsalt, to taste2 tbsp snipped chivesBoil the eggs for 10 minutes, then cool in iced water and peel.Halve the eggs and scoop the yolks into a bowl.Whip the yolks with the mayonnaise, Dijon mustard, a pinch of salt and a drop of green food colouring until smooth.Pipe back into the whites and scatter the chives on top.MainsFirehouse meatball subLong enough for the whole crewHow to make it250g pork mince250g beef mince1 egg40g grated parmesan30g breadcrumbs1 garlic clove, crushedsalt and pepper, to taste700ml passata1 tsp dried oregano4 long rolls8 slices of provoloneMix the pork and beef mince with the egg, parmesan, breadcrumbs, garlic, salt and pepper and roll into 16 meatballs.Bake the meatballs on a lined tray at 200°C for 15 minutes.Simmer the passata with the oregano, add the meatballs and simmer for 15 minutes.Split the long rolls, pack in the meatballs and sauce and lay the provolone on top.Grill for 2 to 3 minutes until the cheese has melted.Firehouse ChineseOut of the boxes, while business is slowHow to make it300g jasmine rice3 eggs2 lap cheong sausages4 spring onions3 tbsp soy sauce2 tbsp vegetable oil24 frozen pork dumplings80ml waterCook the jasmine rice the day before, spread it on a tray and chill overnight.Slice the lap cheong and spring onions and beat the eggs.Heat a wok until smoking with half the oil, scramble the eggs, then add the lap cheong, rice and 2 tbsp soy sauce and toss for 4 minutes until hot. Stir through the spring onions.Fry the frozen pork dumplings in the rest of the oil in a frying pan for 2 minutes until the bases brown, add the water, cover and steam for 6 minutes.Serve out of takeaway boxes with the rest of the soy sauce on the side.SweetsMarshmallow skewersRay roasted these by the fire at Camp WacondaHow to make it16 large marshmallows100g dark chocolate6 digestive biscuits8 bamboo skewersMelt the dark chocolate in a bowl over simmering water and crush the digestive biscuits in a bag with a rolling pin.Push 2 marshmallows onto each bamboo skewer.Toast over a gas flame or under a hot grill, turning often, until the outside blisters.Dip in the melted chocolate, then in the crushed biscuits, and eat while warm.Stay Puft s'moresChoose the form of the destructor. Toast till he meltsHow to make it8 large marshmallows16 digestive biscuits100g milk chocolateLay 8 digestive biscuits on a tray and put a square of milk chocolate on each.Toast the marshmallows over a flame until golden and melting, or sit one on each chocolate square and put the tray under a hot grill for 30 seconds.Press the remaining biscuits on top and eat straight away.DrinksEctoplasm slushieVery green.
